svg.title: SLAP2 glutamate signal-quality analysis
svg.desc: A shows one raw trace and amplitude measurement; B its individual footprint; C through E the three class histograms; F the example-session DMD2 dendritic map beside G, the archive feature space with matching example-source rings and IDs; H shows Low SNR, Intermediate and High SNR composition in four compartment/cohort pools and 20 sessions on one shared vertical percentage axis, without stimulus-context plots. The archive includes 2,540 sources from 20 sessions and 8 mice, with 2,521 classified sources and 19 exclusions. Other modalities remain outside this figure.
